title: Soft French Omelette with Herbs
summary: A tender, silky French-style omelette flavoured with fresh herbs and a little spring onion. It’s quick, light, and perfect for a simple breakfast.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the salt and pepper, and beat just until combined without overwhisking.
Stir in the spring onion and parsley.
Warm the butter in a small non-stick pan over medium-low heat until melted and foaming but not browned.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently with a spatula for a few seconds, scraping the base as the curds start to form.
Tilt the pan and keep the omelette soft and slightly creamy on top, then stop cooking before it dries out.
Fold the omelette into a neat oval and slide it onto a plate immediately. Serve right away.
